item: #19 (second arm) — clock-budget solved-entry reuse re-score (`dfpn` #2), the highest-value remaining unjudged closure per report16
commit: e1d104c (plan17 committed at HEAD; the temporary ATOMIC_CLOCKREUSE hook — src/search/dfpn/plan17_hook.rs wired into core.rs/children.rs/mod.rs/main.rs — plus the temporary examples/plan17_verify.rs were added, measured, and reverted — `git diff --exit-code` verified clean after the revert, release build re-verified, D3(a) salt-0 anchors re-run exact, test_repetition --include-ignored green)
hook: temporary env-gated cross-clock solved-entry index on Search (HashMap<u64, (Move, Outcome, u32)> keyed by the board-only repetition_key, payload (best_move, outcome, proven depth); capacity 1<<18, inserts dropped when full; persists across begin_run like the TT; never serialized): store at the core.rs frame-exit TT store, only for fully solved Win/Loss frame results (draws incl. GHI-suppressed and unsolved bounds never enter; terminal-branch stores excluded); adoption rule rule50 + d <= 100, d <= max_depth, one-ply best_move_repeats_path guard (skipped for Move::NONE, mirroring the exact-key resolved path); arms: ATOMIC_CLOCKREUSE=plan10 -> probe at dfpn node entry (site 1, after the plan9 repetition-cache probe, before sort_moves) AND evaluate_child (site 2, when the exact-key resolved is None; adopted ChildInfo exactly like an exact-key resolved hit incl. proof-event emission and the one child_evals increment); ATOMIC_CLOCKREUSE=arma -> site 1 only, TT store-back at the current full key (remaining_depth = u32::MAX, depth = d, work = 0, pn/dn = outcome.pn_dn_for(is_or_node), best_move = payload move, best_child = u8::MAX) per plan11 mechanism A; unset -> shipped behavior bit-identical (plan16 hook pattern); side-band D3(e) sample dump via ATOMIC_CLOCKREUSE_SAMPLE (first 5 adoptions per run, never affects the search)

verdict: reject / reject: both arms rejected per the pinned rule (D4 applied verbatim); plan10: regressions dec01 (basins=6, 1.95-41.7x, salt-1 catastrophic 270.5 M vs 6.49 M), dec06 (2.48x), dec14 (1.26x) — m22 censored 6/6 (under-budget, informational), stress/m23/dec10 wins insufficient; arma: regression dec14 (basins=3, 1.40-1.46x, outside the quiet band — D7 not triggered) — hard-class support (stress censored-win, m23 win) cannot survive a negative; no defer, so D5 extension does not fire; D6: closure upgraded unjudged -> gate grade, no dfpn hand-off
dispersion: third real-arm calibration data point: plan10 n=118 median 1.000 frac-outside-[0.9,1.1] 48.3%, arma n=125 median 1.000 frac-outside 35.2% — the D7 'strongly bimodal' prediction was wrong; the family is sparse-effect (large byte-identical mass at 1.0 around case-concentrated heavy tails)
notes: Raw transcripts, per-run sample dumps, and anchor files (/tmp/plan17/results, /tmp/plan17/anchors) are not committed per the AGENTS.md measurement layout; driver.py regenerates them deterministically.
Rollout wall: base 2534 s / plan10 3866 s / arma 1587 s at <= 3 concurrent processes (~2.2 h); plan10's m22 censoring (6 x 1 B) and dec01 salt-1 (270 M) absorbed by the caps.

Hook counters over the rollout: plan10 546.5 M site-2 adoptions / 33 site-1; arma 1.21 M site-1 adoptions; both arms hit the 1<<18 index cap only inside censored runs (stress-class m22 plan10 runs); capacity drops deterministic.

arma m22 at distribution grade: 6/6 uncensored, ratios 0.65-1.28x, median 1.027 — the plan11 single 1.28x reading is the worst of six draws; the control is safe for arma but the arm still rejects on dec14.
